claim_boundary: This is a versioned correction/reseal of a conditional actual-log/Farey outlier theorem. It does not construct its core, refute RFDI, prove a full Base common witness or pointwise coefficient condition, prove AFARI/FARI/CFARI/CRR-U, a cubic estimate, a density gain, a short-interval theorem, a saturation theorem, or an L-function result.

conditional_theorem.core: A has R-1 rows in [0,H/4], an interior frozen energy band, a fixed top spectral gap and Lambda>=v^(12-ell*delta(v)), and RationalMass surplus F_A>=(1+epsilon)v^(12-2delta(v)) on the required rational set.
conditional_theorem.failure: DelCov(W)<=8g^(-2)v^(-4+ell*delta(v))<v^(-2s*delta(v)) for every fixed g,ell,r,s with ell+r+2s<2 and sufficiently large v.
conditional_theorem.preservation: For a selected actual tau in [3H/4,H], one common W=A union {tau} retains frozen separation, cardinality, energy, RationalMass, and actual Farey labels.
conditional_theorem.scope: The result blocks only a set-only RFDI inference from scalar/hereditary inputs; it does not show that the full Base coefficient/pointwise condition survives surgery.
conditional_theorem.selection: The actual-log coupling is selected by the elementary C_v mean-value bound, without inspecting the enlarged target eigenvector or Farey outcome.

context.v1_input_status: v1 post-seal convention/document/builder hashes are pinned separately in this correction and intentionally differ from v1's sealed hashes

correction.disposition: v1 is retained as an immutable but nonreplayable post-mutation record; v2 is the replayable versioned correction.
correction.mathematical_effect: v2 makes no stronger unconditional theorem claim. It independently re-seals the conditional theorem, spelling out normalized-bump use and the ell+r+2s budget consequence.
correction.post_seal_mutation: v1 convention/document/builder were edited after v1 sealing; their current hashes are frozen as v1_current_* inputs above, while the v1 artifact bytes remain unchanged.

correction_rows.cause: After v1 sealing, its convention, document, and builder were edited to clarify normalized-bump use and the ell+r+2s budget; v1 artifact bytes were not overwritten.
correction_rows.effect: The changed v1 inputs no longer match v1's frozen hashes, so v1 --check correctly rejects them. The underlying conditional theorem is re-sealed independently here.
correction_rows.remedy: v2 has its own convention, document, builder, tests, artifact, and a pinned mutation ledger; it does not rewrite the v1 artifact.

preservation_rows.energy: For |A|=R-1 and unit-separated A, E(A union {tau})=E(A)+4R-3
preservation_rows.farey: The actual K_F feature kernel and C_theta(sk,rk)=R_W((r/s)*exp(theta/H)) use the same enlarged W
preservation_rows.surplus_transfer: F_A>=(1+epsilon)T_v and T_v>=max(2,8(1+epsilon)/epsilon^2) imply F_(A union {tau})>=T_v
preservation_rows.windows: A subset [0,H/4], tau in [3H/4,H], so pair-sum classes are more than one apart and Base separation is retained

selection_rows.failure: For fixed g,ell,r,s with ell+r+2s<2, the central bound is <v^(-2s*delta(v)) for all sufficiently large v
selection_rows.large_v_mean_value: C_v<=2 for v>=64, from log(v)<=sqrt(v) and L/H=v^(-2)
selection_rows.top_coordinate: |u_W(tau)|^2<=4C_v/(g^2Lambda) for every unit top eigenvector of G_W

falsifiers.correction: A mismatch between the preserved v1 artifact, its sealed hashes, or the explicitly pinned post-seal inputs refutes the correction ledger.
falsifiers.preservation: A failure of the pair-sum energy identity or smoothing Cauchy bound refutes scalar/RationalMass preservation.
falsifiers.scope: An incompatibility theorem ruling out the listed core would redirect the program but would not refute this conditional implication.
falsifiers.selection: A sign/orientation error in the actual-log coupling, mean-value estimate, or block gap argument refutes the conditional theorem.

research_stage_review_policy.lightweight_checks: exact algebra, elementary integral/harmonic estimates, source/convention anchors, replay, and tamper rejection
